_note: Copied from the shipped TY 2026-27 timeline for W-146's synthetic pack, regime references renamed (NEW_TAX_REGIME -> SYN_DEFAULT, SYN_FLAT; FIRST_SCHEDULE_RATES -> SYN_CLASSIC); not law, never shipped. Original note: A land or building sale is computed on the price recorded, while 2025 s.78(1) / 1961 s.50C(1) put the stamp-duty value in its place where the price is below it (and not within the tolerance those sections state) — which can raise the tax. Not built (W-088g6): no stamp-duty value is held. This row only says so, as an ACTION_REQUIRED notice on the bucket's term line (W-088g4, D-432); building W-088g6 deletes it. Sources: docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-11-01-land-sale-provisions.md rows 1, 6–8.
